claims.text: Abscess or cellulitis: POCUS adds to the exam to sort a drainable abscess from cellulitis.
claims.quote: adjunct to physical exam: “to cut, or not to cut” - stratify drainable abscess vs cellulitis

claims.text: It also shows blood vessels and other vital structures to avoid cutting.
claims.quote: improves pt safety: identify blood vessels + other vital structures to avoid cutting

claims.text: IJ central line guidance lowers complications (hemothorax or pneumothorax, arterial injury) and is the standard of care in most institutions.
claims.quote: IJ CVC guidance: ↓complications (hemo/pneumothorax, arterial injury) - visualize vein + needle entering vein - assess fluid status - standard of care in most institutions

claims.text: Vein: thin wall, compressible under the transducer, not pulsatile, low-velocity continuous flow with respiratory variation; flow increases with a distal limb squeeze.
claims.quote: vein: thin wall - COMPRESSIBLE (collapses w transducer pressure) - non-pulsatile - low-velocity continuous flow + respiratory variation - flow ↑ w distal limb squeeze (augmentation)
claims.locator: Point-of-Care Ultrasound (POCUS) › Vessel ID: Artery vs Vein

claims.text: Artery: thick hyperechoic wall, pulsatile, not compressible at normal pressures, phasic Doppler flow; the compression test separates the two.
claims.quote: artery: thick hyperechoic wall - pulsatile - ⍉ compressible at normal pressures - phasic Doppler flow - compression test separates the two
claims.locator: Point-of-Care Ultrasound (POCUS) › Vessel ID: Artery vs Vein

claims.text: Joint effusion: anechoic or hypoechoic fluid distending the capsule; map its margins and depth before the puncture.
claims.quote: effusion: anechoic/hypoechoic fluid distending the joint capsule - map margins + depth before puncture

claims.text: Needle view: in-plane (whole shaft visible) is preferred over out-of-plane (tip only); color or power Doppler helps avoid neurovascular bundles.
claims.quote: needle: real-time: in-plane (full shaft visible) preferred - out-of-plane (tip only) - color/power Doppler → identify + avoid neurovascular bundles

claims.text: LP landmarks: spinous processes are hyperechoic crescents with acoustic shadowing.
claims.quote: landmarks: spinous processes = hyperechoic crescents w acoustic shadowing

claims.text: Probe: linear high-frequency for children and non-obese patients, curvilinear for obese patients or deep targets.
